Learned counsels for both sides are present.
2. Heard the arguments of both sides.

3. This appeal is filed against the dismissal of the claim petition before the II Additional District and Sessions Judge and MACT, Kodagu-Madikeri, sitting at Virajpet, passed in MVC No.70 of 2017 vide judgment and award dated 31.08.2018.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the appellant-claimant has mainly contended that the claimant was driver of the Maruthi Wagnor Car bearing registration No.KL-59/8133 and in order to avoid accident with motorbike coming from the opposite direction, the claimant turned the car to the right side.
He turned the NC: 2025:KHC:34964 HC-KAR vehicle to a trench, fell down and sustained injury.

The learned counsel further contended that the claimant filed an application under Section 166 of the MV Act before the Tribunal and as he could not prove the negligence, the Tribunal observed that the claimant himself was a tort feaser and therefore, not entitled for any compensation.
Further, the learned counsel submitted that a criminal case was filed against the claimant and it was ended in acquittal and thus, he was not the tort feaser.
5. In view of the above submission, this Court finds it just and reasonable to remand the matter to the Tribunal with a direction to decide the case on merits.

6. Accordingly, the following order is passed:
